blocking_design_findings.title: A hash-only termination-evidence argument does not define a verifiable canonical evidence artifact
blocking_design_findings.location: Interface and authority: finish_external_run(..., evidence_sha256), together with Canonical completion and batch accounting
blocking_design_findings.evidence: The reservation metadata has only client, client-source hash and selection hash. finish accepts a64-hex evidence digest, but the contract defines neither canonical evidence bytes/location nor a way for the workspace to read the actual termination evidence. Completion/suite accounting can rehash external-run.json and external-end.json without checking the real evidence whose digest is merely asserted inside the end record.
blocking_design_findings.impact: The promised later-drift and cause-binding checks are underspecified. A valid-looking hash can refer to absent or changed client evidence, or evidence for another session/reservation/selection/cause, while the reservation/end record hashes themselves remain internally consistent. This is a normal evidence-integrity gap even without assuming a malicious operator.
blocking_design_findings.required_resolution: Define an actual bounded canonical termination-evidence artifact, its required session/reservation/selection/client-source/disposition/reason bindings, how finish validates and durably records it, and how close/suite accounting re-read and rehash its real bytes. Define partial-copy/no-end behavior without fabricating a successful seal. The exact successor contract should be independently checked before implementation.

required_precisions_before_code.topic: Meaning and precedence of a genuine final result
required_precisions_before_code.requirement: Define a result as the valid persisted observation/result hash pair accepted by history(), not merely a result.json pathname existing after a crash. A valid final accepted/proof-rejected/invalid/resource-limit/infrastructure result must retain its exact outcome. A valid wall/output-limited final is not an unobserved interrupted action merely because its native result contains an interruption field. Missing observation/result evidence remains interrupted infrastructure; malformed/hash-drifted evidence fails closed. Make the ordered derivation explicit in tests.

Specify the validation order and distinguish malformed provider envelopes/status/identity from well-formed completed model responses with unusable function calls. Only a well-formed, identity-valid response with the exact declared max_output_tokens incomplete cause should become the model-output-budget category; do not derive that classification from an unvalidated envelope. A completed genuine missing/malformed/unknown call can be the stated model protocol/no-final outcome. These are recording-policy distinctions, not a new provider or security acceptance claim.

sound_directions_in_the_candidate: Reserving one external run under the existing operator lock before any provider call, with no overwrite/retry and no new model-facing action, directly addresses the original collection-reservation problem.

No-final infrastructure ends become a distinct unscored infrastructure outcome while all selected targets remain represented. Genuine finals cannot be replaced, forgiven into exclusions or reopened by external failure.

Read-only status does not infer liveness or terminal failure from an unended reservation. Keeping an unclosed child unfinished until explicit close/suite-close after work stops is the correct authority boundary.
One shared outcome derivation for close and suite_status, binding external lifecycle records and actual event history, is the correct direction for preventing completion/rollup disagreement.
No actions after an external end, old closed archive immutability and fail-closed unsupported legacy prototype sessions preserve relevant prior boundaries.

The proposed tests cover final outcomes, interruptions, duplicate operations, drift and actual two-target suite accounting; exact-code review and a credential-free native boundary fixture remain required afterward.
